type: ∀ (r : ℕ) {K : Finset (Trees.TreeFace (r + 1 + 1))}, Trees.IsTreeExpansion r K → ∀ {s : ℕ}, (∀ F ∈ K, Simplify.OutLeafBound F.descr s) → ∀ {k : ℕ}, 3 ≤ k → k ≤ r + 1 + 1 → ((r + 1 + 1).choose k : ℝ) ≤ (16 * ((s : ℝ) + 1) / 3) ^ k * K.card

∀ (r : ℕ), 1 ≤ r → ∀ {K : Finset (Trees.TreeFace (r + 1 + 1))}, Trees.IsTreeExpansion r K → ∀ {s : ℕ}, (∀ F ∈ K, Simplify.OutLeafBound F.descr s) → (16 * ((s : ℝ) + 1) / 3 + 1) ^ (r + 1 + 1) ≤ ((r + 1 + 1 : ℕ) + 1) * (16 * ((s : ℝ) + 1) / 3) ^ (r + 1 + 1) * K.card
